answer: Re-attestations are stored in violet and nectar lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 17 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the ripple graph. A farm of 2114 identities would post 4432 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
